data.long_meaning: Wystan is a Welsh name derived from the Old Welsh elements ‘wyst’ meaning ‘hospitable’ and ‘stan’ meaning ‘stone’ or ‘rock’. It is often interpreted as ‘friend of the forest’ or ‘hospitable one’. The name has been popular in Wales and among Welsh diaspora communities. The name Wystan carries the meaning “Friend of the forest” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Wystan usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of the forest and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It also serves as a reminder of the deep-rooted connections between the Welsh people and their land, which is reflected in the name's forest interpretation.
